s: January 21, 2020 - There's an important distinction between whether or not a shop stocks an item and whether or not they carry an item. Pretty much every LBS out there buys from the same pool of distributors-- QBP, KHS, Hawley, etc. If a distributor has it, they can get it. Full bikes are the exception, because there are dealer contracts in place for all of the big names-- Giant, Trek, Specialized, etc.
